# Reviewed Optimal Engine SDK subset

Four unchanged runtime source files from the user-supplied OptimalEngine 0.3.10 archive. See the accompanying `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, the root `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `.reference/optimal-engine/EXTRACTION_MANIFEST.json`.

Used by `lib/workflow-optimal-engine.ts` and `lib/workflow-context.ts`. No npm install or upstream build script is required. The Elixir server is optional and has not been installed or started by copying these files. Local hardening is implemented in the adapter subclass; upstream SDK source remains unchanged.
